primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: As a measure of pulmonary gas transfer, a standardized lung function test, DLCO, was conducted. The single-breath DLCO test was performed in accordance with American Thoracic Society/European Respiratory Society (ATS/ERS) guidelines for DLCO testing. Results reported as % predicted DLCO adjusted for hemoglobin concentration (%predicted DLCOadj).
